key_findings: NVIDIA closed GDI grows by one per fresh swapchain lifetime, including no-acquire/no-submit/no-present lifetimes; bare window and foundation-only controls remain flat.

A bounded four-cycle observer attributes one desktop GetDC(NULL) acquisition per swapchain to nvoglv64.dll return RVA 0xE1781A. Each distinct HDC remains OBJ_DC after its corresponding complete teardown.
Independent same-thread controls show matching ReleaseDC on diagnostic-owned common DCs reduces GDI count and invalidates the object type; holding DCs reproduces monotonic counts.
Bounded static analysis places the acquisition in a routine resolving wglDescribePixelFormat and returning without saving or releasing its input DC.
Removing CS_OWNDC or destroying the HWND after its surface/device but before its Vulkan instance does not remove the count growth.
An independent raw Win32/Vulkan original reproducer retains NVIDIA GDI 3 through 10 across eight lifetimes; corresponding Intel GDI stays at 3.
